Why Include Warrants In New Equity Issues?
, in a world where investors are uncertain about the riskiness of the firm going public, the firm can signal its riskiness by issuing a package of equity and warrants.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the issuance of warrants with equity can be viewed as a signal of the firm's riskiness.
the issuance of warrants in new equity issues can serve as a signal of firm value and risk.
firms may package warrants with other securities in order to signal to the market that the firm's cash flows are more risky than the market believes.
